ctgov.note: All listed ProQR trials on ctgov are legacy ophthalmology programs; AX-0810 Phase 1 in NL not yet registered on ClinicalTrials.gov

pipeline.modality: ADAR-mediated RNA editing oligonucleotide (EON) — Axiomer platform
pipeline.target: NTCP (sodium taurocholate cotransporting polypeptide) — modulates hepatic bile-acid uptake

indications.trial_design: Single-site Phase 1 in healthy adult volunteers; SAD/MAD evaluating safety, tolerability, PK and PD/biomarker target engagement
indications.trial_status: Recruiting (CCMO CTA authorized Oct/Nov 2025; dosing initiated; early safety + PK data reported)
key_milestones: Target engagement readout H1 2026; additional development candidate selections announced

excluded_preclinical: Additional Axiomer pipeline candidates announced as development candidate selections in late 2025 — preclinical/IND-enabling stage

QR-421a (ultevursen) Phase 1/2 in USH2A RP (NCT03780257) — divested with the rest of the genetic ophthalmology portfolio
QR-010 Phase 1/2 in CF ΔF508 (NCT02532764, NCT02564354) — completed/discontinued
